description: This file defines the setup wizard and configuration functions for integrating Twitch into a CLI application, including account setup, token management, access control, and policy configuration.

methods.name: resolveSetupAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID to use for Twitch setup, prioritizing the default account if specified.

methods.name: setTwitchAccount
methods.description: Updates the configuration with a new or modified Twitch account setup.

methods.name: noteTwitchSetupHelp
methods.description: Displays setup instructions and links for Twitch account configuration.

methods.name: promptToken
methods.description: Prompts the user to input or confirm the Twitch OAuth token.

methods.name: promptUsername
methods.description: Prompts the user to input the Twitch bot username.

methods.name: promptClientId
methods.description: Prompts the user to input the Twitch Client ID.

methods.name: promptChannelName
methods.description: Prompts the user to input the channel to join.

methods.name: promptRefreshTokenSetup
methods.description: Prompts the user to set up token refresh options, including client secret and refresh token.

methods.name: configureWithEnvToken
methods.description: Configures the Twitch account using environment variable token if detected.
